blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Logistics is built from four key activities: transporting, storing, handling, and distributing. Transporting moves goods between places. Storing keeps them safe until they are needed.

Handling is the physical work of loading, unloading, and moving boxes inside a warehouse. Distributing means getting the right product to the right customer at the right time.

Each activity sounds simple. But doing all four well, every day, is the real job of a logistics team. The activities never stop — they just change direction.

items.q: How many key activities does logistics have?
items.why: "Logistics is built from four key activities."

items.q: What does transporting do?
items.why: "Transporting moves goods between places."

items.q: What is handling?
options: Keeping goods safe for a long time
The physical work of loading, unloading, and moving boxes
items.why: "Handling is the physical work of loading, unloading, and moving boxes."

items.q: The text says "the activities never stop." This suggests that…
options: the work happens all the time
the warehouse is closed at night
the team works only one day a week
items.why: Inferência: se nunca param, o trabalho é contínuo, todos os dias.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Each activity has a clear purpose
A logistics team is busy every day
Doing all four activities well is hard work
One activity alone is the whole job
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que o trabalho real é fazer os QUATRO bem — não só um.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily mostrando o armazém para um novo estagiário. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! Let me show you the warehouse. It's your first day, so I will keep it simple.

Look over there. That truck is transporting goods to another city. It leaves in ten minutes. Next to it, two people are loading boxes. That is handling — the physical work of moving boxes by hand.

Now look at these tall shelves. This part is for storing. We keep the goods here, safe and ready, until a customer needs them. Some boxes stay for one day, some for one week.

And here, at the end, is distributing. We put the right product in the right box for the right customer. See these labels? Each one has a name and an address.

Remember one thing: the four activities never stop. When one truck leaves, another one arrives. When one shelf is empty, we fill it again. It is always moving. Any questions? Great — let's start!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where is Emily taking the intern?
items.why: "Let me show you the warehouse."

items.q: What are the two people doing next to the truck?
items.why: "two people are loading boxes. That is handling."

items.q: What are the tall shelves used for?
items.why: "This part is for storing… we keep the goods here."

items.q: Emily says "when one truck leaves, another one arrives." This suggests that…
options: the work is slow and quiet
items.why: Inferência: os caminhões se sucedem, o trabalho nunca para.

items.q: How does Emily seem toward the new intern?
items.why: Inferência: ela dá boas-vindas, explica com calma e diz "let's start!".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We are storing the boxes until Friday." Storing means…
options: keeping goods safe until they are needed
items.why: Storing = armazenar: guardar em segurança até precisar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The workers ___ the boxes onto the truck before it leaves."
items.why: To load = carregar, colocar as caixas no caminhão.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When the truck arrives, we ___ all the boxes and check them."
items.why: To unload = descarregar, tirar as caixas do caminhão.

items.q: "Our job is distributing the products to the shops." Distributing means…
options: getting the right product to the right customer
items.why: Distributing = distribuir: levar o produto certo ao cliente certo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A good team delivers at the right ___, not too early and not too late."
items.why: Right time = momento certo: nem cedo, nem tarde demais.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs comuns em um armazém. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please load up the truck before lunch." To load up means to…
items.why: Load up = encher, carregar completamente.

items.q: "The new system will roll out next month." To roll out means to…
options: start using it step by step
items.why: Roll out = implementar aos poucos.

items.q: "We ran out of space, so we had to set up a second shelf." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = montar, preparar algo novo.

items.q: "Can you check in the boxes when they arrive?" To check in means to…
items.why: Check in = registrar a entrada dos itens.

items.q: "We are almost out of stock; we need to keep up with the orders." To keep up means to…
options: stay at the same speed as the work
items.why: Keep up = acompanhar o ritmo, não ficar para trás.
